These works focus on aerospace medicine, clinical trials, and the use of creative workshops to address the difficulties of implementing traditional randomized controlled trials in isolated, specialized environments like interplanetary missions. Their research in this area involves themes of patient involvement, research infrastructure, and live simulations.
